# netbox_user_group (Resource)

Manages a NetBox group (`/api/users/groups/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_user_group" "example" {
  name = "example"
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `permission_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the assigned Permission (`netbox_permission`). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_user_group can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_user_group.example 123
```
